title: Shared Definitions
description: Reusable types for the chat archive extraction pipeline.

confidence.description: How certain the model is about this extraction.

salience.description: How central this item was to the conversation.

evidence_item.description: A single extracted item with evidence traceability.

interpretation.description: What this might mean or imply.

evidence.description: Direct quotes or specific references from the conversation.

extraction_metadata.description: Metadata present in every extraction output.

source_conversation_id.description: ID of the source conversation from the normalized chat.

source_file.description: Filename of the normalized markdown file.

pass_id.description: Which extraction pass produced this output.

extracted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when extraction ran.
